title: rpl_routing vector initial_multi_parent_grouped_install committed failing (root rejects grouped multi-target DAO)
description: Found running bead y7wh's twister validation on the AWS v3.7.0 builder. test_canonical_route_state_vectors fails on native_sim/native/64 at BOTH HEAD (6212034cbf+beads) and the pinned 65ca175106: 'Assertion failed at lichen/tests/rpl_routing/src/main.c:1233: (accepted not equal to vector->accepted): initial_multi_parent_grouped_install: acceptance (installed): got 0 expected 1'. So the vector was committed failing at the pin commit; not a later regression. Vector: rpl_route_state_vectors.h:408, a 110-byte DAO (dao_len=110) with grouped multi-target RPL Target+Transit-Information options (path_control 0x80 on first, 0x40/0x10 on later targets, path_lifetime 255), expecting accepted=true reason=installed with 5 targets. Hypothesis to check: process_dao/_ex rejects the grouped frame (option framing/overlap check in rpl_dao_process.c per bead 25l3's 'exact DAO option framing' work, or target-count/capacity interplay) OR the fixture generator (generate_rpl_route_state_fixture.py) emitted an inconsistent DAO for a grouped install. Verify against spec DAO framing (spec/07 RPL chapter / draft-lora-rpl) before touching either side; do not weaken the vector without a spec argument. Twister artifacts: /mnt/lichen-zephyr/work/twister-daoauth-y7wh (HEAD) and twister-daoauth-65ca (pin) on the builder EBS. The other 19 cases incl. all four DAO-auth matrix cases named in y7wh PASS.
